column3: We must trust our manager to make the final judgment on this project. (我們必須信任經理會對這個專案做出最終決定。)
The company offered him a substantial raise after his successful presentation. (在他成功簡報後，公司給了他大幅的加薪。)
Good communication is critical for the success of any small team. (良好的溝通對於任何小型團隊的成功都是至關重要的。)
Please let me know your decision about the new contract by Friday. (請在星期五前告訴我您對新合約的決定。)
The new marketing campaign will target young people who love online shopping. (新的行銷活動將鎖定喜愛網路購物的年輕人。)
The police launched a thorough probe into the company's financial records. (警方對該公司的財務記錄展開了全面調查。)
Our head office is in Tokyo, but we also have a branch in Taipei. (我們的總部在東京，但我們在台北也有分公司。)
His sudden departure from the company surprised everyone in the office. (他突然從公司離職讓辦公室的所有人都感到驚訝。)
She put a lot of effort into preparing for her job interview. (她投入了大量努力來準備她的求職面試。)
Please remove your shoes before you enter the traditional Japanese restaurant. (進入這家傳統日本餐廳前，請先脫下鞋子。)
He passed the driving test on his first attempt yesterday. (他昨天第一次嘗試就通過了駕照考試。)

column2: n. 緊急情況；突發事件
column3: In case of emergency, please leave the building through the nearest exit. (發生緊急狀況時，請經由最近的出口離開建築物。)
The managers will attend the annual sales summit in Singapore next week. (經理們下週將出席在新加坡舉辦的年度銷售高峰會。)
Taking a short walk during lunch can help ease your workday stress. (午餐時間散步一下可以幫助減輕你的工作壓力。)
The technical support team quickly worked to restore our internet connection. (技術支援團隊迅速搶修，恢復了我們的網路連線。)
All team members must attend the morning training session on Monday. (所有團隊成員週一都必須參加早上的培訓課程。)

column2: n. 初次登場；首次亮相
column3: The new smartphone made its official debut at the electronics show. (這款新智慧型手機在電子展上正式亮相。)
We watched the exciting football game unfold on the big TV screen. (我們在大電視螢幕上看著刺激的足球比賽進行。)
She decided to buy some shares in a popular coffee shop chain. (她決定買進一些這家知名連鎖咖啡店的股票。)
Could you please break down the budget numbers for this quarter? (你能為大家詳細拆解分析一下這一季的預算數字嗎？)
